out.notes: Yr2 autumn day 2: cold heavy rain, no signs (rain hides tracks). Fire is poor in rain, so I used the horn at the thorn gap. The dog failed against the group of 7 at the thorn gap. If fresh rooting shows, add the ford and lane gaps. Not hunting.
